questions.cardText:
[Religious Studies] In early Christian theology, what is Satan’s role in Hell?
A. Ruler and tormentor of souls
B. Guardian of the gates
C. Prisoner being punished
Answer: C. In early Christian theology, Satan is depicted as a fallen angel who is punished in Hell. However, works like Dante Alighieri’s “Inferno” portrayed Satan as a dominant figure in Hell, which may have led to the subsequent description of Satan as Hell’s ruler in art and literature.
questions.de: Wohinein wird Satan laut der Offenbarung des Johannes nach seiner Niederlage schließlich geworfen, um bestraft zu werden statt zu herrschen?
questions.en: According to the Book of Revelation, into what is Satan finally cast after his defeat, to be punished rather than to rule?

timeline.labelEn: The Book of Revelation is written, traditionally dated to the reign of Emperor Domitian (81–96 AD)
timeline.labelDe: Die Offenbarung des Johannes entsteht, traditionell in die Regierungszeit Kaiser Domitians (81–96 n. Chr.) datiert

questions.notes: Reworked to the fact behind “prisoner being punished”: Revelation 20:7–10 has Satan cast into the lake of fire. The card's explanation is shaky: Dante's Inferno shows Satan frozen mid-breast in ice at the centre of Hell — itself a prisoner, not a ruler; the ruler image owes more to Milton's Paradise Lost (“Better to reign in Hell”). Late-medieval frescoes already showed Satan chained in Hell.

questions.cardText:
[Zoology] Which aquatic animal has been observed to form a queue during evacuation?
A. Fish B. Octopuses C. Crabs
Answer: A. In a recent study, neon tetra fish were observed forming a queue by a small opening when researchers forced them to evacuate using a fishing net.
questions.de: Welcher kleine Süßwasserfisch stellte sich geduldig und ohne Stau vor einer engen Öffnung an, als Forscher Gruppen dieser Fische mit einem Kescher hinausdrängten?
questions.en: Which small freshwater fish was observed patiently queuing at a narrow opening, without jamming, when researchers pushed groups of them out with a fishing net?

timeline.labelEn: Scientific Reports publishes “Fish evacuate smoothly respecting a social bubble”, on queuing neon tetras
timeline.labelDe: Scientific Reports veröffentlicht „Fish evacuate smoothly respecting a social bubble“ über sich anstellende Neonsalmler

source.title: Fish evacuate smoothly respecting a social bubble

questions.notes: Larrieu et al. 2023 (Université Grenoble Alpes), Paracheirodon innesi; the card's answer “Fish” is sharpened to the species its explanation names.
